elements.name: Organisation shell and ownership
copy: Owners set policy and hold billing. They cannot read a member's session or open a shell on a machine they were not granted.
A seat is a person who may attach to machines this organisation granted them. Seats are not metered by machine, and a seat alone reaches nothing until a grant exists.

blocked.reason: Organisation identity, seats and grants are Phase 5 platform work.

elements.name: People, machines and grants
copy: Removing a seat revokes its device credentials and its grants. It does not stop a session already running on a machine, because that machine owns the session. Stop it there.

These are the metered units. A grant gives a seat a route and a credential to one machine, which is not the same as an account login, and never gives the organisation a way to read that machine's code.

blocked.reason: Team seat and machine grant management is not implemented in the current product surface.

elements.name: Organisation audit and policy
copy: What a grant is, and is not

Decisions taken on organisation machines, across everyone. This is a record of choices, not of work: it names the command and the person who allowed it, and it carries no prompt, no diff and no thread.
WHAT AN OWNER CANNOT SEE HERE
A policy is a refusal the daemon enforces on every granted machine. Unlike a rule, no approval, mode or client can permit what it forbids, and the refusal is recorded with the daemon as the actor.
Turning a policy off is not retroactive

It takes effect at the next turn boundary on each machine, and the refusals it already recorded stay in the audit log. A member's machine that is unreachable keeps enforcing the last policy it received.

blocked.reason: Organisation-wide audit and policy surfaces require the Phase 5 control service.

elements.name: Organisation billing
copy: Machines registered to the organisation are what you pay for, in buckets. People are not metered, because a phone answering a gate is not a cost driver and a daemon holding a route is.

blocked.reason: Organisation billing and metering are Phase 5 platform work.
